dragon.note: Rounded shoulder drums, forward missile prow under squat cockpit, broad pelvis and layered shins.

cyclops.note: CP-11-A photographed; CP-10-Z game model. One-eyed visor, inset chest gun and tall narrow opposite rack; weapons not variant-verified.

griffin.note: Sloped shield shoulders, offset cylindrical rack, narrow face, long PPC and stout calf plates.

wolverine.note: Rounded chest, tall narrow cockpit, six-hole adjacent launcher, angled shoulder shields, short gun and visible hands.

firestarter.note: Slim waist and long legs, rounded helmet, small shoulder caps, paired forearm nozzles.

shadow_hawk.note: Offset roof cannon, square helmet, five-hole torso rack, chunky knees, broad split waist armor.

thunderbolt.note: Low offset helmet, large cylindrical upper rack, deeply faceted chest, wide shin armor. Second photograph tagged TDR-7S but same plastic family; weapon comparison provisional.

marauder.note: Sloped elongated cockpit body, raised dorsal gun, two separated paired-bore arms, reverse-jointed legs and tarsal feet.
